To exclude 93041, the floor-of-sum inequality for eighteen positive terms restricts total index N to 5185 or 5186, using exact neighboring floors 93023,93041,93058,93076. The Pell relation 2889^2-5*1292^2=1 establishes theta=9-4sqrt(5)=18/323+delta with 0<n delta<1/323 for 1<=n<=5186. Thus ceil(theta n)=(18n+r(n))/323 where r(n)=323-(18n mod323) in 1..323. For N=5185, summing yields only 17 across eighteen positive residues, contradiction. N=5186 yields 18*323-1, requiring 17 positive multiples of 323 and one index congruent to 18 mod 323, giving N>=5509>5186. Independent exact integer-square-root floor/residue checks for every n through 5186 corroborate the arithmetic. Eventual coverage rests on the inspected published theorem, not finite membership tests.
